name: APOLO INFRA Codespace
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y nginx podman && npm --prefix apps/worker install
postStartCommand: sudo service nginx start || true; mkdir -p data; nohup env APOLO_INFRA_LISTEN_ADDR=0.0.0.0:8787 APOLO_INFRA_DB_PATH=./data/apolo-infra.db go run ./cmd/apolo-infra-daemon > ~/.apolo-sqlite.log 2>&1 & sleep 2; nohup npm --prefix apps/worker start > ~/.apolo-worker.log 2>&1 &
